alias_rule: All modalities, visits and derivatives for a source person inherit one role. Keep existing protected project assignments if an upstream biological alias is later established; quarantine conflicts before any intended-use admission. Unknown overlap is not evidence of independence.

existing_project_assignment_search.result: no prior matching source assignment; metadata only

partition_rule: Preserve every published source person partition. TRAIN is trainset; SELECT is validset; MEASUREMENT_EVAL is testset. No new random split, outcome or image-based selection. Source identifiers are not proof of independent biological identity across upstream datasets.
use_boundary: Generic diffusion/tractography/anatomy component research candidates only. These are derivative human imaging data, not 198 verified glioma cases, surgical retraction measurements, functional ground truth, or admitted policy training.
